items.title: Nick Mondello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 19, 2022
items.q: Thank you, Hamilton College, Milton Fillius, and the endowment

ctx.x: Without a doubt. Thank Glenn Zottola as well, my savant friend. Thank you, Hamilton College, Milton Fillius, and the endowment, your jazz archive and Hamilton College’s jazz archive is something that, as we said before, that both young students and not-so- young students certainly would benefit tremendously. You know? I think that people — we live in an audio-visual world now, so people, you know TikTok and you know Twitter and all of that stuff, you know having people observe those videos. And you know I mean…
